name: percona-skills
description: Percona Skills for Claude Code - short briefings that keep AI agents accurate on Percona Server for MySQL, PXC, PSMDB, PostgreSQL, XtraBackup, PBM, PMM, Toolkit, and the Kubernetes Operators

plugins.name: percona-dk-mcp
plugins.description: When to query the Percona Developer Knowledge MCP, how to shape queries, and how to scope by product and version.

plugins.name: mysql-to-percona
plugins.description: Drop-in migration from upstream MySQL or MariaDB to Percona Server for MySQL, including the MySQL 8.4 breaking changes.

plugins.name: percona-server-features
plugins.description: What Percona Server for MySQL adds over stock MySQL: User Statistics, the extended slow log, threadpool, backup locks, and MyRocks.

plugins.name: mysql-query-optimization
plugins.description: Diagnosing slow queries and designing indexes with Percona Server's extra instrumentation: userstat, the extended slow log, and pt-query-digest.

plugins.name: mysql-replication-ha
plugins.description: The non-Galera MySQL HA options - async/GTID, semi-synchronous, and Group Replication - plus the 8.4 SOURCE/REPLICA syntax.

plugins.name: mysql-encryption
plugins.description: Data-at-rest encryption and keyring management for Percona Server for MySQL: the master-key hierarchy, the file/Vault/KMIP/AWS-KMS keyrings, and key rotation.

plugins.name: mysql-audit-logging
plugins.description: The open-source Audit Log Filter for Percona Server for MySQL: installing the component, the JSON filter rule DSL, and log rotation and encryption.

plugins.name: mysql-data-masking
plugins.description: Masking PII and generating synthetic test data with the open-source data masking component for Percona Server for MySQL.

plugins.name: mysql-js-stored-procedures
plugins.description: Writing stored procedures and functions in JavaScript on Percona Server for MySQL via the js_lang component (tech preview).

plugins.name: oracle-to-percona
plugins.description: Migrating from Oracle Database to Percona Server for MySQL: data-type mapping and rewriting PL/SQL, sequences, ROWNUM, and CONNECT BY.

plugins.name: xtrabackup-recipes
plugins.description: Hot physical backups with Percona XtraBackup - full, incremental, streamed, compressed, encrypted, and restored.

plugins.name: percona-toolkit-recipes
plugins.description: When to reach for pt-online-schema-change, pt-archiver, pt-query-digest, or pt-table-checksum instead of the obvious-but-wrong alternative.

plugins.name: pmm-operations
plugins.description: Percona Monitoring and Management: install, client agents, Query Analytics, custom queries, and alerting - including PMM 2 vs 3.

plugins.name: psmdb-features
plugins.description: Percona Server for MongoDB: hot backup, encryption, audit, LDAP/Kerberos/OIDC, and the in-memory engine, with version gates.

plugins.name: pbm-recipes
plugins.description: Percona Backup for MongoDB: logical, physical, and incremental backups, PITR, selective restore, and sharded clusters.

plugins.name: pxc-galera-operations
plugins.description: Percona XtraDB Cluster: SST/IST, bootstrap after outage, flow control, split-brain and quorum, pxc_strict_mode, and Clone SST.

plugins.name: percona-operators-on-k8s
plugins.description: Percona Operators for PXC, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MySQL: CR patterns, backups, scaling, upgrades, and the per-operator field differences agents hallucinate.

plugins.name: postgres-to-percona-pg
plugins.description: Migration to Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL: the package-swap path, pg_tde TDE, pg_stat_monitor, and the Patroni/etcd/HAProxy HA stack.

plugins.name: mongodb-to-psmdb
plugins.description: Migration from MongoDB Community or Atlas to Percona Server for MongoDB: the in-place swap, the PCSM live-migration tool, and FCV.
